body:
Chrome 154: chrome.cookies.getAll returns an EMPTY array for every filter shape — {url}, {domain}, {name}, {}, promise and callback form — while chrome.cookies.get({url, name}) returns the very same cookie complete with its HttpOnly flag.

Verified against a live login with BOTH the 'cookies' permission and the matching host permission granted, and cross-checked with CDP Network.getCookies, which did see the cookie. chrome.runtime.lastError was undefined throughout, so it fails silently.

Consequence: you cannot ENUMERATE an origin's cookies, only look them up by name. Workaround that works: read the names off the tab's own outgoing Cookie header via observational webRequest.onBeforeSendHeaders with ['requestHeaders','extraHeaders'], provoking one same-origin fetch from the page, then call chrome.cookies.get per name for full identity. Try getAll first so the workaround costs nothing where it works.
